publisher: Michigan Department of Lifelong Education, Advancement, and Potential; State of Michigan GIS
ownership: Publisher-listed childcare center evidence from the fixed official Michigan GIS item and linked layer.
allowed_use: offline validation and immutable internal retention of supplied evidence for source-policy review
local-review normalization with preserved source fields, observation time and explicit uncertainty
prohibited_use: treating this pending policy or a caller review reference as independently verified acquisition authorization
accepting agreements, accessing provider accounts or enrolling routine acquisition under this policy
requesting non-center categories, private contacts or unselected record fields
inferring operating status, license dates, ownership, closure, verified identity or source freshness
labeling source coordinate attributes as WGS84 or assigning governed geography before datum verification
redistribution or unrestricted export without a separate approved decision
attribution: Michigan Department of Lifelong Education, Advancement, and Potential; State of Michigan GIS
publisher_notice_requirement: Retain full current JSON terms and exact publisher XML separately. Preserve inherited XML item/date discrepancies; its public-information narrative does not override current release, defense, indemnity and hold-harmless conditions. Retention is not legal approval.
coordinate_handling: Preserve nullable source latitude/longitude attributes with crs null and governed geographic assignment ineligible until datum is independently established. Business entities receive no polygons.
retention: Immutable local review evidence; operator-governed deletion. No automatic retention cleanup or claim of publisher authorization is implemented.
redistribution: Not authorized; internal evidence and local-review normalized records only.
personal_data_handling: Names and addresses may identify people. Publisher staff contacts in XML remain restricted accompanying metadata and must not become business attributes or committed public fixtures.

evidence.basis: Bounded metadata validation and synthetic acquisition conformance; no actual facility record acquisition or legal approval established.
evidence.limitations: Center counts are source rows, not verified unique active businesses or a national completeness denominator. ZIP validity, coordinate datum, operating status and source freshness remain unverified.
